# Municipal Ordinance No. 07, Series of 2020

**Kautusang Bayan Blg. 07**

*Isang Kautusang Bayan na Nagtatakda ng mga Patakaran, Alituntunin at Regulasyon sa Pag-Kontrol ng Sakit na African Swine Fever (ASF) at iba pang Sakit ng Baboy na Nakakahawa sa Nasasakupan ng Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon*

An ordinance prescribing policies, guidelines, and regulations for the control of [[African Swine Fever]] (ASF) and other contagious swine diseases within the jurisdiction of the [[Municipality of Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]].

## Summary

Enacted on October 28, 2020, this ordinance establishes policies, guidelines, and regulations to control the spread of [[African Swine Fever]] (ASF) and other contagious swine diseases within [[Pitogo]]. The measure was enacted in response to the ASF outbreak affecting the Philippine swine industry and aims to protect the local hog-raising sector, which is a significant livelihood in the municipality. The session was presided by [[Paul Timothy C. Villaflor]] as Acting Presiding Officer, with Mayor [[Dexter L. Sayat]] absent from the session. A follow-up ordinance, [[MO-11-S2021]], later established an ASF Task Force.

## Key Provisions

- **Declaration of Policy.** The municipality commits to preventing and controlling the spread of ASF and other contagious swine diseases within its jurisdiction.
- **Preventive Measures.** Establishes quarantine checkpoints and monitoring systems for the transport of live hogs and pork products entering and leaving [[Pitogo]].
- **Reporting Requirements.** Mandates the immediate reporting of suspected ASF cases to the [[Municipal Agriculture Office]] and the [[Bureau of Animal Industry]].
- **Movement Control.** Regulates the movement, transport, and trade of live swine and pork products within and across municipal boundaries.
- **Biosecurity Standards.** Prescribes biosecurity protocols for hog farms and backyard raisers to prevent the introduction and spread of ASF.
- **Disposal of Infected Animals.** Provides guidelines for the humane depopulation and proper disposal of infected or exposed swine.
- **Penalties.** Violators shall be subject to fines and penalties as prescribed under the ordinance.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
